svg.text: Drum: turn 36 mm across, 27 mm long; 6 mm bore, a press

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: fit on the shaft (or pin it). Two grooves 1 mm deep,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 10.5 mm either side of the middle, one for each wire.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill and tap M3 across each groove for a wire clamp

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: screw with a washer; the wires lie on opposite sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft hole to the end, rounded; 6 mm hole; thumb peg

svg.text: 12 mm across riveted at the end.
